w: So where would the new money go? Next year, the City's own requests add up to about three hundred fifty-five million dollars. Nearly a third falls under safety: the Safer Together plan, police, and more transit peace officers. Almost as much falls under infrastructure, led by sixty-two million dollars a year for infrastructure maintenance. Transportation comes next, mostly transit: a low-income pass and more service. And nearly eight of every ten dollars is ongoing. If approved, it carries into every later year's budget.
